paragraphs.text: Sevinne is a human chronarch from Dominaria with a taste for adventure and a love of exploration.

After being trained at the Tolarian Academy in temporal magic , he grew restless with book learning and left to roam the world as soon as he had gained his wizard's mantle. As a gifted sorcerer with an encyclopedic knowledge of the arcane arts, he relies on his magical prowess to aid him in his escapades across Dominaria.
